card.name: Wiki stub and help-wanted notices
card.fires_on: The word "can" after "You" in wiki notices like "This article is a stub. You can help...". It also fires on other words inside calls for readers to help or contribute.

modes.label: Stub notice
modes.description: "can" after "You" in a stub message inviting readers to expand the article.
modes.example: This Laos-related article is a stub. You<< can>> help Wikipedia by expanding it.

modes.label: Other wiki maintenance notes
modes.description: Words inside cleanup tags or contributor credits asking for or naming outside input.
modes.example: This article needs attention from<< an>> expert in Psychology.

modes.label: Invitation to participate
modes.description: Words in web text inviting readers to join in or get in touch.
modes.example: Stay in touch If<< you>> are using LP/Lisp, drop me

card.writes: It pushes words like "Someone" and "Somebody", which fit an appeal for a person to step in.
card.plain: It marks the spot in wiki notices where the text asks a reader to help or contribute.
